content: jose v6.2.8 is a zero-dependency JWT/JWS/JWE library confirmed to support Cloudflare Workers, Node.js, Deno, Bun, Browsers, and Electron. It exclusively uses Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle) and standard Web APIs, making it compatible with V8-isolate edge runtimes like EdgeOne Edge Functions. Provides SignJWT class for signing and jwtVerify function for verification.
